svg.title: The Hand-Sewn Book: Blackwork embroidery on linen
svg.desc: The Hand-Sewn Book (1D): an open book of linen pages, its glyphs worked in black silk as counted-thread blackwork. Scrambled glyph strips lie on the left page; on the right, a row of slots edged in red, black or white thread waits to be filled in the one legal order, and a strip is being carried to its slot. When the line pulls taut its translation appears below: "They weren't made. / They were summoned."
